radar/mark-static.note: the Morse mark: inner four at .9, outer eight at .3, no animation. Same static frame in the toast, panel header and empty state (they used to pulse as if a model were working)

radar/mark-live.note: pulses only while a model works (bar mark + phase hint)

picker/hover-small.note: label 20px tall on the 4px grid, mono 11px, r-sm; box sits 3px outside the target

picker/hover-top-edge.note: flush with the top edge the label moves inside the box instead of off-screen

picker/hover-right-edge.note: label is shifted left to stay 4px inside the viewport

picker/selected.note: dashed outline = selected, solid + ring = hover

bar/picking.note: row 48px (8 + 32 + 8), status 40px; placeholder, model label and counts use --m-text-3 (now AA)

bar/chip-x-hover.note: close glyphs are the × character, not an SVG: 14px in a 20px hit box in the chip, 18px in 28px boxes in the panel and modals. Consistent, but swapping them for a 1.8-stroke SVG like the Run arrow would need markup in 70-panel.js/80-modals.js

bar/typing-long.note: the input scrolls; the chip keeps its 44% cap and ellipsis

bar/fixing.note: the error is one line with an ellipsis; the phase word and timer always stay visible

bar/error.note: long errors end in an ellipsis inside the hint (was clipped mid-glyph). The full text is not reachable from the bar: a title attribute on the hint would need a one-line change in 60-generate.js

bar/result-long-repaired.note: the title gives way first; the timing and 'repaired once' and all four actions stay

bar/result.note: Keep is focused after a keyboard submit, so its ring shows; Enter keeps

effect/*.note: radar field in --m-signal-1..4 over --m-overlay; follows the target's shape. Cosmetic: when the target is not a multiple of 8px the last row/column of cells is cut by the canvas edge

effect/page-thinking.note: page-wide: a scan runs around a 2-cell band at the viewport edge

effect/page-writing.note: page-wide: Morse blips appear in the top and bottom bands

pulse/success.note: one 900ms ring, r-md; with reduced motion it is skipped

motion/reduced-effect.note: prefers-reduced-motion: Effects default to Subtle, a still outline on the target (it was hidden by God mode's selection rule, now kept); two frames 450ms apart are pixel-identical

motion/reduced-mark-live.note: prefers-reduced-motion: the working mark is a brighter static frame (inner 1, outer .55) instead of pulsing

toast/long.note: capped at 480px, wraps; mark aligned to the first line

panel/mods-0.note: empty state: static mark, 24px line rhythm

panel/mods-12.note: there is no 'broken mod' state in the runtime: a mod whose JS throws on apply only raises a toast, the row looks healthy (the fixture's `broken` field is ignored). Needs data from the host and a row style; out of scope for CSS

panel/row-unbroken-title.note: an 80-character unbroken title and prompt wrap anywhere instead of pushing the row wider than the panel; disabled rows use --m-text-2/3 instead of 50% opacity, so they stay AA

panel/row-off.note: off = muted text and gray switch; still AA

switch/on-focus.note: the hidden checkbox now draws a focus ring on its track (there was none)

switch/off-focus.note: the hidden checkbox now draws a focus ring on its track (there was none)

modal/code.note: code is not wrapped (white-space: pre) and scrolls horizontally

modal/code-long.note: long title wraps; × stays top-right instead of floating mid-title

modal/share.note: the share card is a fixed dark PNG drawn by renderCard() in 80-modals.js (not tokens, by design: it is posted outside the app). Its 'BEFORE' caption is #3a3a40 on #0b0b0c (1.6:1) and the footer line #8e8e96 at 15px; suggest #8e8e96 for the caption. Left to the 80-modals.js owner

modal/import-error.note: import errors surface as a toast above the scrim

hostile/hostile-hover.note: page: * {all: unset}, [data-morse-ui] {display:none !important; transform: scale(2) !important}, html zoom 1.25 + font-size 40px, dir=rtl, rotated body, Comic Sans everywhere. Overlay unchanged; the box is the rotated element's bounding box

hostile/hostile-noise-hover.note: same page, plus `div { --m-text: #f0f !important; ... }` and `[data-morse-ui] { --m-bg: red !important }`: the overlay's own tokens win

edit-toolbar/selected.note: tag (mono 11, --m-text-3), then 32px .ibtn tools in three groups split by 1px lines; 40px toolbar (3 + 32 + 3 + 1px border), r-md, the shared .pop surface

edit-toolbar/bar-hint.note: after pointing, typing goes to the bar; Ctrl+E (⌘E) moves focus to the toolbar

edit-toolbar/*.note: tooltips: name + key cap after 300ms, one at a time; focus is a flush 2px ring; pressed tools are primary; disabled tools are --m-signal-1 with no tooltip

edit-toolbar/ctrl-e.note: the toolbar takes focus as a whole (its border lights) and H M R T C F D A act on the selection, but Tab does not walk its buttons: 50-bar.js's Tab trap only cycles the bar. Needs a few lines of key handling in 45-godmode.js (arrow keys are taken by nudging); out of scope for a CSS pass

edit-frame/resize-handles.note: eight 8px handles centered on the 1px frame (r 2, the frame's hairline radius)

edit-frame/move-dragging.note: the readout is the picker's label: inverse mono 11px, r-sm, under the frame

edit-frame/embedded-note.note: frames: the note says what works; tools that reach inside are disabled

edit-frame/text-editing.note: dashed frame while editing; the text itself is selected

edit-color/*.note: tabs are the shared .seg; swatches 20px round with a 2px gap ring when picked; the hex input is a .field with an inline 24px eyedropper

edit-color/hex-invalid.note: invalid hex: --m-danger border ring and text (the input has a pattern); Enter keeps the text selected to retype

edit-type/*.note: Size: a .field stepper with 24px ± buttons; Weight: the shared .seg, each label in its own weight

edit-type/default.note: the popover opens under the toolbar and covers the selection when there is no room above it; placement lives in place() in 45-godmode.js (logic, not CSS). Esc closes it

capture/popover.note: thumbnail 112px tall in a raised r-sm well; the note is a .field; Capture is a .btn.primary with the inverse key cap

capture/*.note: the thumbnail in the catalog comes from the fake host's page screenshot

page-tools/*.note: a .menu: 32px rows, 16px icons, detail on the right (level, check); the button's tooltip hides while its menu is open

clipboard/chips.note: 32px chips on the bar's 16px inset: 40×24 thumbnail, label, app; the row scrolls sideways

clipboard/rebuilt-from.note: while working, the snapshot that rides along with the request is shown as “Rebuilt from”

voice/*.note: errors are one line in the status row (warn dot + --m-text-2), ellipsis when long; the mic nudges

voice/listening.note: the mic widens to a 48px well with the level meter in radar pixels; the bar border lights

voice/transcribing.note: the mic shows the working radar; placeholder says Transcribing…

menu/*.note: the ⋯ menu is the same .menu as Page tools: 32px rows, key caps right-aligned, row highlight + inset ring for focus

settings/*.note: a solid sheet (--m-surface) inside the bar; rows 40px min, label 13/16 + help 11/16; controls right; eyebrow section labels

settings/sheet-narrow.note: phone width: segmented controls drop under their label

hotkeys/*.note: the hotkey control is a .field (28px) holding 20px key caps

hotkeys/recording-held.note: held modifiers show as caps next to the listening radar; Turn off appears

hotkeys/rejected.note: rejected: shake + --m-danger ring and message (light --m-danger is now #c4262e, 5.6:1)

hotkeys/warning.note: accepted with a warning in --m-warn; Reset appears for a custom key

shortcuts/*.note: two columns of 32px rows; every key is the same 20px cap

suggestions/*.note: chips are quiet .btn (28px, r-sm) on the 16px inset; Tab reaches them, ←/→ move

history/*.note: ↑ in an empty input recalls earlier prompts; nothing else changes

stop/working.note: Run turns into Stop (raised well, 8px square); focus moves to it

stop/cancelled.note: Stopped · nothing was changed · Enter to run again; the prompt stays

hostile/hostile-text-edit.note: the page's `[data-morse-ui] { display: none !important }` used to hide the text being edited; the edit span now carries !important inline display/visibility

fixes.title: 1. A page rule (`[data-morse-ui] { display: none !important }`) hid the whole overlay; zoom, dir=rtl and --m-* variables also leaked in. Host styles are now !important, direction is pinned, html zoom is countered, tokens are !important inside the shadow root
2. Hover label off-screen for elements flush with the top edge (every app header)
3. Same on a real site: The Daily Byte's top bar
4. Hover label ran off the right edge
5. 390px: result actions ran off the screen (Share cut)
6. 390px: hint clipped mid-word, model label off-screen
7. Long result title pushed Share out of the bar and hid the timing
8. Long error clipped mid-glyph with no ellipsis (text-overflow on a flex box)
9. Light theme: warning text #e5a54b on white was 2.0:1 (new light --m-warn #8a5300, 5.5:1)
10. --m-text-3 failed AA in both themes (2.9–3.6:1): placeholder, model label, timings, field labels, row buttons. Now #86868e / #6a6a72 (≥4.5:1 worst case)
11. Focus ring was 24% white (~2:1); now --m-signal-3, 2px, offset 2
12. Switch had no focus indicator at all
13. Unbroken titles overflowed the panel; disabled rows dropped to 50% opacity (below AA)
14. Code modal wrapped code and floated × mid-title
15. Toast had no max width (one 950px line)
16. prefers-reduced-motion was ignored: the effect pinged, scanned and blinked; now a calm static field that fades
17. Phone width: the edit toolbar ran 130px off screen. Now the tag and group lines drop and the eleven 32px tools fit in one 360px row (wrapping if narrower)
18. Toolbar focus was a 1px inset line, and a focused tool's tooltip stayed up while hovering another (two tooltips). Now the shared 2px ring, one tooltip at a time
19. Same in light: the 1px ring is now the 2px --m-signal-3 ring every control uses

20. Settings sheet: the edit toolbar sat on top of the bar, the picker's hover box drew through the sheet and the page showed through it. The sheet is solid now, the toolbar steps aside and pointing pauses
21. An invalid hex color looked exactly like a valid one. The field now turns --m-danger (pattern + :invalid)
22. Page tools: the button's tooltip covered its own open menu, and the menu used a different focus style than the ⋯ menu
23. Two menus, two designs: the ⋯ menu had 34px rows, 5px padding and 2px-bottom key caps. Both are one .menu now (32px rows, 4px padding, shared caps)
24. Light theme: a rejected hotkey's message was #f2555a on white (3.4:1). Light --m-danger is #c4262e (5.6:1), and the field gets the same red ring as other invalid fields
25. “Rebuilt from” never showed: the bar turned working before the request picked up the snapshot, so the chip row hid. One re-render after the hook
26. The bar row mixed three icon sizes (14/15/16px), three strokes (1.8/1.6/1.5) and three button sizes (30/32 with r 8). Now 32px .ibtn squares, 16px icons, 1.5px strokes
27. Suggestion chips were 26px pills inset 42px; now quiet 28px .btn on the bar's 16px inset
28. Type popover: 30px stepper buttons with 14px icons, a second segmented-control design. Now 24px .ibtn in a .field, and the shared .seg
29. Capture: the footer hint wrapped to two lines and the key cap was a third style. Shorter hint, shared .btn.primary with the inverse cap
30. Phone width: the input was squeezed to “Des” (with a stray scrollbar) and segmented controls crowded their labels. The mark gives way, the chip caps at 40%, segments drop under their label
31. Hostile page: `[data-morse-ui] { display: none !important }` hid the text being edited in place (Publish vanished). The edit span now holds its display with !important
32. Key caps had three designs (16px inline, 20px with a 2px bottom border and r 5, borderless in tooltips). One cap: 1px line, r 4, 16px inline / 20px in sheets and menus
